snippet.title: Trailer First world - Gears of Glory
snippet.description:
This trailer shows some of the towers and enemies you will face in Gears of Glory.
In a post-apocalyptic world ruled by machines, you are humanity’s last hope — with your battle rig.
Crush your enemies and save humanity.
